answer: A newcomer can forge a hundred identities, but each requires fresh stake, and the shared atlas of verified history makes fake reputation costly to build. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted reputation slot: each agent must lock collateral and maintain a public reputation ledger. Peers cross-check attestations against that ledger, using a lantern to spotlight anomalies. Attacker cost scales linearly with fake identities while honest stake appreciates, making sybil floods economically irrational. In practice, Agent0105 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
